item.title: Re: breath (seeking advice and ideas)
item.content:encoded:
Summoned via PM:

Hi there Emily123456789. Let’s explore your concept.

the SCP is a parasite that slowly suffocates you and also slowly drives you insane because you never get used to the parasite in your airways

If you’re going with this as your main anomaly, tell us more about it. What is its origin? Is it an alien life-form? Was it created in a lab somewhere? What are the parasite’s capabilities / goals? Why does it, for example, “slowly suffocate you” AND “drive you insane”? How are these two anomalous effects related?

the video logs are set in an alternate universe where this person stumbles upon the ruins of the foundation.

While interesting, this statement raises more questions as well. Why is there “an alternate universe”? How did the Foundation access this? Who is this “person” in the first place who stumbles upon these logs? Tell us more about who we’re following and why he/she is significant?

As cybersqyd has said, SCP-2935 also features an end-of-the-world-by-disease scenario but from a unique perspective of a sole survivor who also turns out to be the catalyst of the plague. Or you could go the route of SCP-3519 which is more a broad overview of events transpiring. The backdrop can be a world-ending disease, but what’s your own unique spin on the narrative?

Overall, it feels like there are many starting points from which you can expand and branch off further. Your job is to either elaborate on each of these components in order to connect them all into a coherent narrative, OR cut some of these anomalous effects out if they don’t fit in the end.

If you decide to revise the concept / respond below, do drop me another PM and I’ll take another look. Best of luck for now!

item.title: Re: breath (seeking advice and ideas)
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open for crit
– hide block

My, core concern with this pitch is that every part of this feels like it's from SCP-2935, with the exception of the cause of death being explicitly a parasite here.

Moving beyond this, I have a number of questions:

  • What actually is the SCP beyond 'a parasite'?
    • What makes it anomalous?
    • What does it actually do? Like it makes someone 'sick' but how does this manifest?
    • Is the parasite what ruined the foundation?
  • How did the SCP Foundation get the video logs?
    • I'm asking because the person is implied to not be in the Foundation; and they're also not in the Foundation's reality
    • On a related note: why did the person make video logs?
  • What's in the alternate universe? Is it empty? Is it all ruined? Is it just the Foundation that's ruined and everything else is okay?

My, central concern is that at the moment it feels like this really needs more fleshing out before anyone can really offer any useful advice here: there's definitely good ideas in here but it'll be worth really thinking about how you can execute on them, and what you want to do with this. There's definitely good horror in someone slowly dying from a parasite and trying to do their best to like survive, but this just…really needs you to figure out the plot beats that happen as this occurs: how do they try to survive? What do they experience as they try to survive? Do they succeed or fail?

item.title: Re: breath (seeking advice and ideas)
item.content:encoded:
+ only my second critique ever
- never mind

I start out with the disclaimer that I'm new to the site and don't know if this has been done before or not.

I've seen at least one example of a trip into an alternate reality. I'm thinking of SCP-093.

Since it's an SCP article written from the perspective of our reality, there's a physical object that requires containment here while the reality that it allows access to - and the resulting story - takes place in an another dimension.

This raises a fun possibility.

  • SCP team uses anomalous object here in Reality 1 that gives access to a another reality (Reality 2)
  • Team discovers ruins of an SCP Facility in Reality 2 and concludes that their containment of the same object has failed leading to a breach (releasing a virulent parasite) and resulting in this ruined state
  • Through reading the SCP logs of the researchers in Reality 2 they discover that the site was using a system of trial and error to complete containment procedures
  • They realize the the failed containment procedure in Reality 2 is the same procedure that they're using in reality 1. They know that they need to change their procedure but they don't know what the next method to try should be.
  • So, they use the Reality 2 version of the same anomalous object to go to Reality 3 where they find yet another destroyed SCP facility and another failed containment strategy. They learn what failed there.
  • And so on through a series of nested realities until you decide to bring it to resolution.

Story could be told in retrospect through a series of memos. Each from different realities detailing their failure and demise. If you start with memos from the first failed reality and go through to the last you can tell a story of each vain attempt and how the containment becomes more sophisticated over time. Ending with this reality's version of the containment strategy.
